Overturned Vehicle Causes Delays On New Circle Road Posted: Updated: 
LEXINGTON, Ky. (LEX 18)-- The inner loop of New Circle Road at Floyd Drive was shut down to one lane Friday morning due to an accident involving an overturned vehicle. 
Police say the driver of the van was taken to the hospital, but was walking around and talking before. 
An officer tells LEX 18 the driver is lucky it wasn’t worse. WEATHER Thursday, January 4 2018 2:28 PM EST 2018-01-04 19:28:56 GMT MGN LEXINGTON, Ky (LEX 18) It's going to be cold the next few days, and Lexington Emergency Management wants to make sure you know what items to not to leave in your car. You can read their list below: Cellphones and smartphones – They’re generally pretty sturdy, but extreme cold can take a toll on batteries, circuit boards and screens.
